description: This file defines options and configuration handling for Kubernetes cloud provider webhooks, including flag parsing, validation, and listener setup.

classes.name: WebhookOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration for enabling or disabling webhooks.

classes.name: WebhookServingOptions
classes.description: Holds server options for webhook serving, including TLS and listener configuration.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Adds command-line flags for webhook options.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the webhook options against known webhooks.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Applies webhook options to a WebhookConfiguration.

methods.name: NewWebhookServingOptions
methods.description: Creates a new WebhookServingOptions with default or specified bind address and port.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Adds command-line flags for webhook server options.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Applies server options to server configuration and webhook configuration.
